title: The log-likelihood peaks at λ̂ = 0.3
caption: For waiting times 2, 3, 5 the log-likelihood is 3 ln λ − 10λ, which is largest at λ = 3/10 = 0.3: the maximum likelihood estimate.
alt: Graph of 3 ln λ − 10λ against λ, rising steeply, peaking at λ = 0.3 and then falling slowly.
description: With n = 3 and total 10, ln L(λ) = 3 ln λ − 10λ.
Its derivative 3/λ − 10 is zero at λ = 0.3.
The curve has its maximum there.

checks.name: the log-likelihood is largest at λ = 0.3
